# Copilot Instructions

This repository is a React-based e-commerce UI demo application featuring product listings, cart management, and checkout flows.

## References

- See [docs/copilot/tech-stack.md](docs/copilot/tech-stack.md) for tech stack details.
- See [docs/copilot/coding-standards.md](docs/copilot/coding-standards.md) for coding standards.
- See [docs/copilot/build-test.md](docs/copilot/build-test.md) for build, test, and lint commands.

## Behavioral Guidelines

- Use functional React components with props destructuring and default parameters.
- Follow established naming conventions for components, files, and variables.
- Manage state using React Context for global state and useState for local state.
- Style components with dedicated CSS files using the defined class naming patterns.
- Run linting and build commands to ensure code quality before finalizing changes.
- Avoid introducing new dependencies or patterns not already present in the codebase.
